questions.stem: A 32-year-old man had excision and primary closure that was 5x3 cm on the forearm, 1 year ago. options.text: Set a "quit date" with the patient
Give clear, personalized advice to quit

questions.stem: A 56-year-old man presents to the clinic for evaluation. The physician has difficulty in obtaining accurate information regarding reason of attendance. Which of the following is the most appropriate next step in consultation?

options.text: Use medical terms that the patient understands
Control the interview with direct questions
Involve the patient in the treatment plan

questions.stem: A 76-year-old man admitted with diagnosis of pneumonia has fluctuating levels of attention, changes in awareness, and a marked disturbance of the sleep/wake cycle. Which of the following is the most appropriate initial management?

options.text: Isolation in a quiet, dark room
Allow a relative to stay with the patient

questions.stem: A 27-year-old woman delivered a healthy baby 3 months ago. She is currently undergoing psychotherapy for postpartum depression. Which of the following is the most appropriate to be added to optimize treatment?

options.text: Prescribe very small doses of imipramine

options.text: Admit into the hospital to gain confidence

questions.stem: A 77-year-old woman is admitted to Neurology Ward with right hemispheric intracranial bleeding. 5 days after admission the physiotherapist reported verbally to the nurse that the patient left buttock is getting red with skin loss. The nurse forgot to tell the resident and no action was taken. 2 days later, the patient spiked a fever with hypotension. On examination, the resident found purulent discharge from the pressure sore. Which of the following is the best approach to prevent this incident?

An inter was attending Operation Room for laparoscopic nephrectomy for suspicious renal mass. The urologist asked to prep for the right kidney approach. However, the intern remember from his history and exam that it was the left kidney. Which of the following is the most appropriate action by the intern?

options.text: Keep quiet since he might be wrong
Leave OR and check the electronic note
Call the chief intern to ask for guidance
Inform the surgeon about his concern

questions.stem: While doing ward round the consultant surgeon asked the resident to write Pipercillin-Tazobactam for their patient. The pharmacist reported that the patient has a questionable allergy to penicillin. The consultant insisted to write the order. Which of the following is the most appropriate action by the resident?

options.text: Write the order and let the consultant sign it
Write the order then call chief surgeon to complain
Gently refuse to write the order
Write the order and keep quiet fearing retaliation
